name_zh: 阿姆德（安贝德卡）：从贱民之子到宪法架构师的『达利特解放』与制度重构治理范式
name_en: Ambedkar (B.R. Ambedkar): From Dalit Son to Constitution Architect — the 'Dalit Emancipation' and Institutional Reconstruction Governance Paradigm
description_zh: 阿姆德拜·拉奥·安贝德卡（B.R. Ambedkar，1891-1956）是印度宪法之父、首位法律与财政部长，以及达利特（贱民/不可接触者）权利的最坚决捍卫者。他以法学、经济学和社会学的跨学科功底，将印度社会最深层的种姓矛盾转化为宪法工程化的制度重构方案。
description_en: Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar (1891-1956) was India's Father of the Constitution, first Law and Finance Minister, and most determined defender of Dalit (untouchable) rights. With interdisciplinary expertise in jurisprudence, economics and sociology, he transformed India's deepest caste contradictions into constitutionally-engineered institutional reconstruction programs.
reason_zh: 核心思维：在「印度独立初期、种姓制度根深蒂固」背景下，以「宪法工程化+达利特权利制度化+社会改革立法」三重体系——将种姓平等从道德呼吁转化为可操作的宪法条款（第14-18条废除不可接触制、第17条明确废除不可接触制），以「保留席位制度」确保达利特在政治中的代表权，以「印度教法典法案」推动种姓、婚姻和继承制度的根本变革。其「宪法架构—制度保障—社会立法」三位一体工程，填补了南亚「从边缘群体到国家治理核心」的唯一样本。
reason_en: Core Thinking: In 'early Indian independence, caste system deeply rooted' context, engineered 'constitutional engineering + Dalit rights institutionalization + social reform legislation' triple system — transforming caste equality from moral appeal to operable constitutional articles (Articles 14-18 abolishing untouchability, Article 17 explicitly outlawing untouchability), ensured Dalit political representation through 'reserved seat system', and promoted fundamental transformation of caste, marriage and inheritance systems via 'Hindu Code Bill'. His 'constitutional architecture–institutional guarantee–social legislation' trinity fills South Asia's sole sample of 'from marginalized group to core state governance.'
steps_zh: 第1步：矛盾锁定——从「印度独立后种姓压迫与宪法民主的内在冲突」中识别主要矛盾为「不可接触制对基本人权的系统性剥夺」，确立宪法平等条款优先于宗教传统
第2步：制度工程设计——以「保留席位」为核心机制，在议会和地方机构为达利特和部落民设定法定配额；将种姓废除写入宪法第17条，使反不可接触制从道德原则变为可司法执行的法定义务
第3步：社会改革立法——推动《印度教法典法案》试图将种姓、婚姻、继承和收养制度全面世俗化与平等化，虽因政治阻力未完全通过，但奠定了印度家庭法现代化的法律基础
第4步：宪法框架工程化——将「主权、世俗、民主、共和」四大原则与「基本权利+国家政策指导原则+义务」三维结构整合为可操作的治理系统，以「联邦制+单一性混合体」平衡中央与地方权力
第5步：从边缘到核心——将「矛盾锁定→制度设计→社会立法→宪法框架」四环沉淀为发展中国家在多重社会分裂中通过宪法工程实现国家统一的可操作范式
steps_en: Step 1: Contradiction Locking — Identify primary contradiction from 'internal conflict between caste oppression and constitutional democracy in post-independence India' as 'systematic deprivation of basic human rights through untouchability system'; establish constitutional equality provisions superseding religious tradition

Step 2: Institutional Engineering Design — Use 'reserved seats' as core mechanism, setting statutory quotas for Dalits and tribal peoples in parliament and local bodies; codify caste abolition into Constitution Article 17, transforming anti-untouchability from moral principle to justiciable legal obligation

Step 3: Social Reform Legislation — Advance 'Hindu Code Bill' to comprehensively secularize and equalize caste, marriage, inheritance and adoption systems; though not fully enacted due to political resistance, laid legal foundation for modernization of Indian family law

Step 4: Constitutional Framework Engineering — Integrate 'sovereign, secular, democratic, republican' four principles with 'fundamental rights + directive policy principles + duties' three-dimensional structure into operable governance system; use 'quasi-federal unitary hybrid' to balance central and state powers

Step 5: From Margins to Core — Sediment 'contradiction locking → institutional design → social legislation → constitutional framework' four rings into operable paradigm for developing nations achieving national unity through constitutional engineering amid multiple social divisions
expected_zh: 掌握安贝德卡从「不可接触者之子」到「印度宪法之父」的根本转型路径
理解保留席位制度、宪法第17条和印度教法典法案三者的系统关联
评估安贝德卡宪法工程对当代印度社会公平与多元民主治理的持续影响
expected_en: Master Ambedkar's fundamental transformation path from 'untouchable son' to 'Father of Indian Constitution'
Understand systemic linkages among reserved seat system, Constitutional Article 17 and Hindu Code Bill
Evaluate Ambedkar's constitutional engineering influence on contemporary Indian social equity and pluralistic democratic governance
case_zh: 1947-1950年印度制宪会议：安贝德卡作为宪法委员会主席，在种姓、宗教、语言多元分裂的印度设计了世界上最详细的成文宪法。他以「保留席位」确保达利特在议会和地方机构中的政治代表权；将不可接触制写入宪法第17条明确废除，使反歧视从道德呼吁变为可司法执行的法定义务；推动《印度教法典法案》试图将种姓、婚姻和继承制度全面平等化。作为首位法律与财政部长，他设计「混合联邦制」平衡中央集权与地方自治；1956年，在生命最后阶段皈依佛教并带领数十万达利特集体改宗，以宗教转换完成对种姓制度的最终否定。其「宪法工程—制度保障—社会立法」三位一体范式，使印度成为全球最大的民主国家中唯一在宪法层面系统处理种姓问题的案例。
case_en: 1947-1950 Indian Constituent Assembly: As Chairman of the Constitution Committee, Ambedkar designed the world's most detailed written constitution amid caste, religious and linguistic plural fragmentation. He used 'reserved seats' to ensure Dalit political representation in parliament and local bodies; codified untouchability abolition into Constitution Article 17, transforming anti-discrimination from moral appeal to justiciable legal obligation; advanced 'Hindu Code Bill' attempting comprehensive equalization of caste, marriage and inheritance systems. As first Law and Finance Minister, he designed 'quasi-federal unitary hybrid' balancing central authority with local autonomy. In 1956, during final life stages, he converted to Buddhism and led hundreds of thousands of Dalits in mass conversion, completing ultimate repudiation of the caste system through religious transformation. His 'constitutional engineering–institutional guarantee–social legislation' trinity paradigm makes India the only case of a democratic nation systematically addressing caste at constitutional level.
